_comment: People the fact-check (scripts/factcheck-people.mjs) would change, read by a person and judged wrong or unsettled ON WIKIDATA. They are listed as doubtful in docs/people-factcheck-2026-10.md and left as they are. 'resolved' marks the ones checked against two sources in Oct 2026 ('resolved': the pin is right, the Born line is set by hand in accuracy-fixes.json; 'uncertain': sources still differ and the panel says so).
